study type: Prospectively planned meta-analysis of individual participant data from randomized clinical trials
outcome: Major disability (bilateral blindness, deafness, cerebral palsy, Bayley-III cognitive or language score <85)
cohort: A total of 4965 extremely preterm infants born before 28 weeks' gestation were randomized across 5 clinical trials.
finding: There was no significant difference between a lower SpO2 target range compared with a higher SpO2 target range on the primary composite outcome of death or major disability at a corrected age of 18 to 24 months.
